items.title: 13.10 Reactions of chlorine with cold and hot aqueous sodium hydroxide

blocks.title: Disproportionation reaction
blocks.text: A reaction in which a single element undergoes both oxidation and reduction simultaneously is a disproportionation reaction.
When chlorine reacts with cold and with hot aqueous sodium hydroxide it disproportionates, forming different products according to the temperature (13.10.1 and 13.10.2).
